reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of the range
  SELECT DISTINCT month_start AS month
  FROM calendar
  WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
), parents AS (
  -- one row per parent category
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_category
  FROM categories
), monthly AS (
  -- one row per parent category and month with sales
  SELECT parent_category, order_month AS month, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY parent_category, order_month
), grid AS (
  -- one row per parent category and month of the range
  SELECT p.parent_category, m.month, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units
  FROM parents p
  CROSS JOIN months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly s ON s.parent_category = p.parent_category AND s.month = m.month
)
SELECT parent_category, month, units,
  units - LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_category ORDER BY month) AS change_units
FROM grid

solver.query:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT parent_category, CAST(mo AS DATE) AS month
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT parent_category FROM categories) p
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-06-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS g(mo)
), monthly AS (
  SELECT parent_category, CAST(order_month AS DATE) AS month, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY parent_category, CAST(order_month AS DATE)
), j AS (
  SELECT g.parent_category, g.month, COALESCE(m.units, 0) AS units
  FROM grid g LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.parent_category = g.parent_category AND m.month = g.month
)
SELECT parent_category, month, units,
  units - LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_category ORDER BY month) AS change_units
FROM j
